title: Vanilla Rebalance
description: Vanilla Rebalanced tightens Minecraft's progression without adding new content. Same game, just in the right order.
body:
Minecraft is beatable in 20 minutes. This fixes that. If you know what you're doing, a vanilla playthrough goes: punch tree, get ender pearls, find stronghold, beat dragon, roll credits. 90% of the game's content is completely skippable. Vanilla Rebalanced doesn't add anything new — it just makes sure you actually play the game before you beat it.

# What's changed

## Eye of Ender
The portal recipe now requires ingredients from across the game world. You need a Blaze Rod from the Nether, a Breeze Rod from Trial Chambers, and an Echo Shard from an Ancient City — on top of the Ender Pearl. You're not finding the stronghold until you've earned it.

## Elytra
Firework rockets no longer boost elytra flight. The elytra is a glider, not a jet. Plan your routes, use your environment, and maybe build that minecart network after all.

## Warden
The Warden is now a proper boss — 100 HP, a boss bar visible within 64 blocks, and real drops on death: a sculk catalyst, 1–4 echo shards, and 1–3 diamonds. Fighting it is now a legitimate strategy, not just a last resort. Night Vision counters the Darkness effect, rewarding players who come prepared.

## Totem of Undying
The totem still drops from Evokers. It still triggers on death. But instead of launching you back to full health, it curses you — Weakness II and Slowness III for 90 seconds. You survived, but now you have to live with it.

## Villager Trading
The experimental Trade Rebalance datapack is enabled by default. Enchanted books are locked behind specific biome villagers — Mending requires a swamp librarian at expert level. Trades lock permanently on first use, so there's no resetting for better options. The economy is real now.

## Minecarts
The Minecart Improvements datapack is enabled by default with max speed set to 20. With the elytra nerfed, rail networks are worth building again.

## Mounts
Tamed and saddled horses, donkeys, mules, and camels no longer wander. The Happy Ghast moves 1.5× faster than vanilla when harnessed. Your mounts stay where you left them.

Philosophy Every change in this pack is a rebalance, not a replacement. No new items, no new mobs, no new structures. If it wasn't already in Minecraft it isn't here. The goal is a playthrough that feels like the game always should have — where the Nether, the Deep Dark, and Trial Chambers are necessary stops on a journey, not content you skip on the way to the end credits.

Technical

✅ Server-side only — no client mod required 
✅ Fabric, Minecraft 26.1.2 
✅ Compatible with vanilla clients
